I'm a mathematics tutor based in San Diego, specializing in Precalculus and Calculus I for community college students. I also work with high school and elementary students. I hold a B.S. in Mathematics from the U.S. Naval Academy and an M.S. in Business Analytics from UC San Diego, and I'm completing an M.S. in Finance at Golden Gate University.

Before tutoring, I served 10 years in the U.S. Navy as a Hospital Corpsman and a commissioned officer, and I bring the structure and discipline of that service to my teaching. My next goal is a master's in mathematics and, ultimately, teaching at the college level.
